data.one_liner: Network inspector for Dart/Flutter that captures and visualizes HTTP requests during development.
data.what_it_does: It starts a local Niddler server that intercepts HTTP traffic from your app and forwards it to the Niddler IntelliJ/Android Studio plugin. It can capture request stack traces and replay responses from saved HAR files.
use_when: You need to debug and inspect network calls in a Flutter or Dart app
You want request‑site stack traces or the ability to replay responses
You are developing on desktop/mobile and can run the IntelliJ plugin
avoid_when: Running in production where performance overhead matters
You cannot install the Niddler IDE plugin
You prefer a pure logging solution without a UI
strengths: Deep integration with IntelliJ/Android Studio plugin
Supports stack‑trace capture and HAR replay
Works across all major Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Adds runtime overhead, not suited for release builds
data.setup_notes: Add the package, create a NiddlerBuilder, call start() (optionally with waitForDebugger), and install the Niddler plugin in IntelliJ/Android Studio. Wrap main with Chain.capture for full stack‑trace support.
